import cadquery as cq
half_width = 10.96
outer_radius = 27.4
cap_radius = half_width
cap_center = outer_radius - cap_radius
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(cap_center, half_width)
    .lineTo(outer_radius, half_width)
    .lineTo(outer_radius, -half_width)
    .lineTo(cap_center, -half_width)
    .lineTo(half_width, -half_width)
    .lineTo(half_width, -cap_center)
    .lineTo(half_width, -outer_radius)
    .lineTo(-half_width, -outer_radius)
    .lineTo(-half_width, -cap_center)
    .lineTo(-half_width, -half_width)
    .lineTo(-cap_center, -half_width)
    .lineTo(-outer_radius, -half_width)
    .lineTo(-outer_radius, half_width)
    .lineTo(-cap_center, half_width)
    .lineTo(-half_width, half_width)
    .lineTo(-half_width, cap_center)
    .lineTo(-half_width, outer_radius)
    .lineTo(half_width, outer_radius)
    .lineTo(half_width, cap_center)
    .lineTo(half_width, half_width)
    .lineTo(cap_center, half_width)
    .close()
    .extrude(7.4)
)
show_object(result)
